decisions.reason: Because this 2024 product line is tightly linked to the firm's core plant-equipment business, supports its automation strategy, and can be sustained by the firm's engineering and service slack despite the firm's demonstrated willingness to cull weaker launches.

Because production analysis software fits the firm's move toward future-ready automated precast plants and service-based lifecycle support, management would likely keep it while market feedback is still forming, though the earlier rapid withdrawal of several 2023 launches raises the drop risk if adoption falls below aspiration.
